in_greek.long_meaning: The name Letti may have Greek origins, as it can be derived from the Greek word λέττος (lettos), which means 'milk'. This name could be given to a child as a symbol of nourishment or abundance.

in_latin.name: Letitia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Letti may have Latin origins, as it can be derived from the Latin word lētus, which means 'happy'. This name could be given to a child as a sign of joy or contentment.
